name: screendocs
description: Screenshots, videos and descriptions of every screen of a website, including pages behind a login.
long_description: Ask Claude to document a website and it captures every page with the Chrome or Edge installed on your computer: one screenshot per section, on desktop and mobile, a full-page image and a video scrolling each page, with emails, phones and filled form fields blurred. Claude then looks at the screenshots and writes a title and description for each screen into an HTML report. Everything runs on your computer; no API key is needed. Requires Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.

folder.title: Folder for the captures
folder.description: Where the screenshots, videos, reports and saved logins go.
